1.0.43.en: Prepared the independently published Local webOS TV Controller community release with original Store artwork, clear upstream credit and unchanged television-control behaviour from the live-verified 1.0.42 baseline.

1.0.42.en: Removed the unusable inherited Artwork token after the LG G4 returned HTTP 404 for every tested app-icon source; all verified Flow cards remain unchanged.

1.0.41.en: Ensured existing-device capability migration completes before connecting, so all LG power, volume, app, sound-output and channel subscriptions start reliably after an upgrade.

1.0.40.en: Replaced misleading Artist, Track and Album change cards with accurately named app/input and channel display values while retaining the proven dedicated Flow cards.

1.0.39.en: Prevented brief LG WebSocket restarts from generating false television off/on Flow events while retaining confirmed power-state detection.

1.0.38.en: Removed the unsupported image-token notification card after repeated LG G4 tests timed out, while retaining the working notification card with its optional icon field.

1.0.37.en: Replaced the misleading generated Next and Previous cards with accurately named Fast forward and Rewind actions after live LG G4 USB-recording tests verified their actual behaviour.

1.0.36.en: Removed the inherited Is playing condition after LG G4 protocol and live playback tests proved that the television does not expose a reliable playback-state signal. Play, Pause and Toggle actions remain available.

1.0.34.en: Reinstated the inherited Is playing condition for further controlled user testing while retaining all live-verified volume and mute repairs.

1.0.33.en: Added compatibility with the LG G4's nested live volume and mute response while retaining support for the inherited response format.

1.0.32.en: Repaired relative-volume migration and live volume/mute conditions, and replaced the unreliable playback-state condition with explicit media command cards.

1.0.31.en: Corrected existing-device volume capability options to Homey's normalized percentage scale without changing the known-good pairing and discovery implementation.

1.0.27.en: Clarified the two channel cards and limited app choices to user-facing launch targets.

1.0.26.en: Verified channel changes after LG acknowledgement and added a fallback check for silently stale Live TV channel information.

1.0.25.en: Completed LG's two-stage authorisation handshake and saved the accepted key before connecting.

1.0.24.en: Completed the required dropped-image placeholder in the notification Flow title.

1.0.23.en: Completed required formatted Flow titles for alert and notification arguments.

1.0.22.en: Corrected channel-token examples and added manifest-schema and translation consistency checks.

1.0.21.en: Cancelled timed-alert work during reconnect or deletion and removed legacy plaintext key-file handling.

1.0.20.en: Added the required driver icon and strengthened offline Store-manifest checks.

1.0.19.en: Bounded and shared remote-button socket connections so failed button actions cannot hang.

1.0.18.en: Prevented overlapping LG connection attempts and cancelled reconnect work after deliberate disconnect.

1.0.17.en: Prevented pending LG commands from hanging after WebSocket disconnection or registration timeout.

1.0.16.en: Isolated LG registration payloads so multiple televisions cannot share mutable pairing state.

1.0.15.en: Prevented transient power-subscription errors from incorrectly marking the television off.

1.0.14.en: Removed an unnecessary development dependency and regenerated the dependency lockfile.

1.0.13.en: Tightened package exclusions for development, generated and sensitive files.

1.0.12.en: Improved pairing resilience when discovery data, addresses or MAC information are invalid.

1.0.11.en: Aligned declared device capabilities with runtime behaviour and added manifest-to-handler consistency checks.

1.0.10.en: Serialised reconnection and ignored stale callbacks after connection replacement or device deletion.

1.0.9.en: Added bounded network requests, image-size limits and safer alert input validation.

1.0.8.en: Stored LG pairing credentials privately and improved Node.js 22 network and buffer compatibility.

1.0.7.en: Improved Store descriptions and corrected English and Dutch Flow-card wording without changing card identifiers or television-control behaviour.

1.0.6.en: Declared the app as a local Homey LAN integration and tightened exclusions for development, evidence and secret-bearing files.

1.0.5.en: Registered Flow cards once per app start and made pairing, autocomplete and discovery errors complete reliably instead of hanging or being hidden.

1.0.4.en: Flow actions now report failed LG commands as errors instead of completing successfully or changing Homey state prematurely.

1.0.3.en: Added bounded recovery for failed Live TV channel subscriptions without creating duplicate active subscriptions.

1.0.2.en: Improved reconnection after TV address or polling changes and ignored stale events from replaced connections.

1.0.1.en: Corrected the volume card's percentage scale and LG/Homey volume conversion. External ARC/eARC audio devices may retain their own volume.

1.0.0.en: Created an independently identified development fork from the frozen, tested LG G4 source. No intended television-control behaviour changed.
